requirement.description: The DomainLookupTestCase fails with "KeyError: 'Domain 'a' not found in fragment hierarchy'" indicating that the lookup_domain method in the Design class doesn't properly traverse the fragment hierarchy to find domains.
requirement.contract: Implement a robust domain lookup mechanism in the Design class that can traverse the fragment hierarchy to find ClockDomain objects by name, accounting for domain renamings and proper parent-child relationships between fragments.

requirement.description: Multiple simulator regression tests fail with AttributeError because PySimEngine is missing essential methods like tick, set, posedge, changed, delay, get, and add_background_testbench_process.
requirement.contract: Implement all missing methods on PySimEngine class that are required for simulator functionality: add_background_testbench_process, tick, set, posedge, changed, delay, and get methods that align with the base simulation engine interface.

requirement.description: The MemoryTestCase fails due to incomplete implementations for async_read and sync_read memory operations in the RTLIL backend, causing test failures with "end." errors.
requirement.contract: Implement the missing async_read and sync_read methods in the RTLIL backend memory conversion functionality to properly generate RTLIL code for asynchronous and synchronous memory read operations.
